title: Astronaut Galaxy Star Projector – Remote-Controlled Night Light
body_html:
Experience celestial magic with the Astronaut Galaxy Star Projector night light, designed to bring a calming starry sky ambiance to any room. This projector features an astronaut theme, blending space charm with soft rotating nebula and star patterns for a relaxing atmosphere perfect for bedrooms, kids' rooms, or modern home decor.

Key features

  • Astronaut-inspired galaxy and nebula projections for a unique cosmic experience
  • Rotating starry sky effect to create a soothing nighttime environment
  • Remote control equipped allowing effortless mode and brightness changes
  • USB powered for convenient and flexible use
  • Compact design ideal for tabletops in bedrooms and living spaces
  • Enhances bedtime ambiance and works as a stylish decorative light
  • Perfect gift option for kids and space enthusiasts

Materials & care

Constructed with durable materials ensuring long-lasting use. Wipe clean with a dry cloth to maintain the projector’s finish. Avoid exposure to water or harsh chemicals.

FAQ

Q1: What is the Astronaut Galaxy Star Projector?
A: It is a night light projector featuring astronaut-themed galaxy and nebula designs that project rotating stars and cosmic lights to create a relaxing ambiance.
Q2: How do I control the projector settings?
A: The projector comes with a remote control to easily adjust lighting modes and brightness levels from a distance.
Q3: What power source does it use?
A: It is USB powered, allowing convenient connection to power banks, adapters, or computer USB ports.
Q4: Is it suitable for kids?
A: Yes, it is perfect for kids' bedrooms, providing a calming nightlight with fun space themes.
Q5: Can it be used as a decorative light?
A: Absolutely, its unique astronaut design and starry effects enhance any home decor with a cosmic touch.

Product Dimensions

Length 10 cm
Width 13 cm
Height 8 cm
Weight 239 g
